newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby Union-Whelan confident of an Ireland win.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Whelan confident of an Ireland win.

text.p: Manager Pat Whelan said on Tuesday he is confident Ireland will beat Western Samoa when the sides meet in a one-off international at Lansdowne Road this evening (kick-off 1930 GMT).
"The mood in the squad is good. We have had six very intensive sessions and we are quite confident we can win the game...and I think we will," Whelan said.
Ireland will line-out against Western Samoa with two new caps in the back division in centre Robert Henderson and left winger James Topping.
Loose head prop forward Nick Popplewell had to cry off the team on Sunday with a hamstring injury and his place has gone to Leinster's Henry Hurley.
Hurley's only previous appearance for Ireland was when he came on as a temporary replacement against Fiji last season.
Western Samoa, who beat Irish provincial side Munster 35-25 in Cork, southern Ireland, at the weekend, will have former All Black Va'Aiga Tuigamala on the wing.

Tuigamala, capped 19 times by New Zealand, will be making his full debut for Western Samoa after he came on as a replacement late in the Munster game. He has played against Ireland once before, in the first test in Dunedin in 1992.
In all Western Samoa will line out with four new full caps, the others are winger Afato So'oala, outside-half Earl Va'aa and number eight Isaac Feaunati.

IRELAND: 15-Simon Mason; 14-Richard Wallace, 13-Robert Henderson, 12-Jonathan Bell, 11-James Topping; 10-David Humphreys, 9-Niall Hogan (Captain); 8-Paddy Johns, 7-Denis McBride, 6-David Corkery, 5-Jermey Davidson, 4-Gabriel Fulcher, 3-Paul Wallace, 2-Allen Clarke, 1-Henry Hurley.

WESTERN SAMOA: 15-Veli Patu; 14-Afato So'oalo, 13-To'o Vaega, 12-George Leaupepe, 11-Va'Aiga Tuigamala; 10-Earl Va'a, 9-Joe Filemu; 8-Issac Feaunati, 7-Pat Lam (Captain), 6-Sene Ta'Ala, 5-Mark Birtwistle, 4-Potu Leavasa, 3-Afa Le'uu, 2-Tala Leiasamaivao, 1-Billy Reidy.
